messages:
lee_newhire: hi all, quick onboarding question — where should I stash my day-to-day ramp notes vs stuff that should be 'official' in Notion? also how do I get edit rights to the team onboarding templates?
jordan_devex: welcome Lee! Personal ramp notes = Notion 'My Pages' or a private page in Team Docs > Onboarding > Personal Ramps. Official living docs belong in Team Docs > Product > Onboarding and must go through docs review.
maya_docs: @lee_newhire I can grant edit to the onboarding templates. Which template do you need to edit? we have: "Engineer Ramp (private)" and "Engineer Ramp (canonical)" — the canonical one is locked except for docs maintainers.
lee_newhire: want the private one first. also curious: do we ever export ramp notes for backups or to share with manager?
it_ops: we run a weekly Notion export for compliance. Private pages are not included unless you move them under Team Docs or explicitly share. If you want weekly export of a page, create a share link and add it to the export list via the internal form: https://internal.redwood/digital-ops/notion-export-request
maya_docs: suggested naming: "Ramp - Lee [YYMMDD]" for versioning, and add a property 'privacy' = private. If something becomes company-useful, move it to Team Docs and open a docs-review PR (docs-review template is in Team Docs > Process).
jordan_devex: to get edit on the private template I need your @email. alternatively you can request via the devex request form: https://redwood.com/devex/request (select 'Notion edit access').
notion_bot: System: Access change queued for maya_docs to invite lee_newhire to Team Docs edit group. SCIM/SAML sync may take up to 15 minutes.
lee_newhire: thanks everyone! I'll use "Ramp - Lee" and request the invite via the form. pinging @maya_docs if the invite doesn't show up. :raised_hands:
